scrap.prompt:
Design a single source sheet for an ORIGINAL side-scrolling industrial prison game prop, with EXACTLY THREE equally sized cells in a single horizontal row, ordered left to right as instructed. No dividers or visible layout marks. Use flat opaque saturated MAGENTA #FF00FF across blank background, including all gaps and holes. In each cell, centered subject kept wholly in bounds with large blank padding on every side. Use an orthographic side-scroller elevation view, visually simple large matte, lineless angular color planes, hard edges, 2-3 tones per material, key lighting from upper left. Preserve identical dimensions and viewing angle for persistent geometry, draw the three stages as the SAME object. Art for crisp low-color rendering, avoid noisy small dabs, soft gradients, transparent edges, floor, shadows on ground, blur, motion streaks, lettering, numerals, icons, signatures, figures and watermarks. The supplied card is a game material and hue reference only; do not copy another object or the text from it.
This sheet is for one TALL rectangular industrial SCRAP PILLAR prop, final 120px wide by 240px tall, tall slender aspect approximately 1:2 for first two states. A vertical rough industrial supporting beam of three angular masses of rust-orange sheet metal locked by broad graphite steel braces, chunky dark bands and minimal large bolts, darker side facets, zinc worn edges. It is a gameplay PLATFORM with one broad level metal cap. Its outermost top edge MUST be one long ruler-straight perfectly HORIZONTAL pixel-aligned top with flat corners, no lip bump, jagged top, leaning or slope, even if a front beveled stripe shows BELOW the edge. Choose composition making the cap as wide as the column, roughly 95% of visible width. LEFT falling: same flat cap and vertical silhouette, angular sharpish broken steel at the lower base showing it has not yet settled, small highlights in metal only, vertical. MIDDLE firmly planted: the flat continuous light-edged rectangular cap is obvious as a place to stand, straight robust sides and a wide stable flat foot. Show the full exact cap and pillar. RIGHT crumbling: same opened sheared steel braces giving way, a broken cap now broken into a couple of angled segments and falling close, cracks and fragments, footprint stays centered at the same y, visible height around 68% of planted version. Keep debris tightly clustered. Individual props only, no effect outside. Canvas wide landscape around 3:2 so the tall forms fill each cell vertically.

A rusted cast iron straight vertical pipe, two matching circular couplings, one compact scarlet-rust handwheel with three chunky spokes in front, flat circular dark slate mounting plate, and a right-side top elbow leak outlet.
